svg.title: イングランドの旅の地図
svg.metadata: Target land: GSHHG/GSHHS high-resolution shoreline via Basemap 2.0.0 (Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith; https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/wessel/gshhg/), assigned with Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 map subunits ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19 (public domain) unit ENG (England); internal land boundaries follow Natural Earth. Surrounding land: the same GSHHG shoreline, drawn to the canvas edge. WGS84; local-equirectangular-fit-v1, 1200x760. Wales, Scotland, Isle of Man, Ireland and continental Europe are context only.
